chunks: And whatever is in it from Masʿadah ibn Ziyād, I have narrated it from my father; and from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with them both—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allāh; and al-Ḥimyarī, all together, from Hārūn ibn Muslim, from Masʿadah ibn Ziyād.

key_terms.جَمِيعًا: together; indicating combined transmission from the named authorities
key_terms.عَنْ أَبِي: from my father; an immediate link in the author’s sanad/isnad
key_terms.عَنْ مَسْعَدَةَ بْنِ زِيَادٍ: from Masʿadah ibn Ziyād; the named point of transmission in this chain
key_terms.فَقَدْ رَوَيْتُهُ: I have narrated it; a transmission formula used by the compiler

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Masʿadah ibn Ziyād in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the compiler transmits narrations from Masʿadah ibn Ziyād in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. It serves as a chain-of-transmission note identifying the intermediaries between the author and Masʿadah ibn Ziyād.
